descriere:
Nivel de vechime: Asociat
Tip de angajare: Full-time
Sectoare de activitate: Servicii IT și consultanță IT
Who We Are
 We are seeking a Senior or Lead Technical Architect / Software Architect with a strong product and platform mindset, able to translate business and product needs into executable, scalable and sustainable architectures and technical solutions. The role will provide technical leadership to one squad and coordinate decisions, dependencies and standards with other squads and technical stakeholders. The profile should be primarily focused on architecture, design, technical reviews and solution definition, with sufficient engineering judgement and depth to drill into implementation where required. The candidate must bring cloud-native experience across Azure, Kubernetes and Docker, solid CI/CD practices, and an end-to-end understanding of backend and frontend architecture. A core requirement is knowledge of AI agents and product-oriented agentic ecosystems, including harnesses, tools, MCP and Semantic Kernel, together with an up-to-date view of the leading AI capabilities and products in the market.
 What You'll Be Doing
Define the target architecture and technical solutions for the platform/product, including components, integrations, interfaces, deployment and key design decisions
Translate functional and non-functional requirements into patterns, standards and technical decisions that engineering teams can implement
Provide technical leadership to one squad, setting architecture, design and technical direction, and coordinate effectively with other squads to resolve dependencies and maintain consistency across solutions
Establish lightweight and effective technical governance mechanisms: architecture reviews, ADRs, standards, guardrails, quality gates and technical acceptance criteria
Carry out architecture/design reviews, technical analysis of components, APIs and integrations, and validation of solutions proposed by the squad
The role is not focused on day-to-day implementation, but requires sufficient technical depth to review decisions, identify risks and guide concrete solutions
Design or evolve cloud-native architectures on Azure using Kubernetes and Docker, considering resilience, scalability, security, operability and cost
Define and improve CI/CD practices, delivery lifecycle automation, quality gates, artefact management and promotion between environments
Maintain an end-to-end view of backend and frontend architecture, even when implementation is distributed across different teams or technologies
Design and/or oversee product capabilities based on AI agents, tool use, orchestration and agent harnesses, including integration with existing systems and APIs
Assess emerging AI ecosystem capabilities and translate them into practical product innovation opportunities
Collaborate with Product, Engineering, Platform/DevOps, Security and other architects to ensure technical decisions support product objectives
Raise the technical standard of the squad through architecture and design reviews, technical mentoring and clear quality criteria, promoting team autonomy and alignment with other technical leaders
 What You'll Bring Along
Degree in Computer Science, Engineering or equivalent experience
Strong background in architecture and technical leadership
Software Architecture: solution design, APIs, integrations, NFRs and architectural patterns
Full-Stack Development: strong backend expertise and solid understanding of frontend architectures
Python & TypeScript: hands-on experience in modern software and AI solutions
CI/CD & Cloud-Native: automated pipelines, containers and Kubernetes
Agentic AI: hands-on knowledge of AI agents, orchestration, tool calling, MCP and Semantic Kernel
AI Engineering: LLM/RAG integration, evaluation, observability and production readiness
Azure / AKS and Infrastructure as Code
Technical Leadership: squad leadership, architecture ownership and cross-team coordination
English: minimum B2
Nice-to-have:
Observability, security and SRE practices
Event-driven architectures and microservices
LLMOps / AgentOps
Experience with enterprise or regulated environments
